fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are the envelope fields merged with the ENTIRE upstream NewsArticle ld+json object spread verbatim (no field allowlist), so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here will commonly appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss, site-wide RSS 2.0 feed) carry title/link-style headline fields instead.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

@type.title: Schema.org type
@type.description: The upstream ld+json node's @type, e.g. NewsArticle/ReportageNewsArticle/Article.

@context.title: Schema.org context
@context.description: The upstream ld+json node's @context, raw passthrough.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle node.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full plain-text article body, carried inline in the ld+json node. Every sampled article carries isAccessibleForFree:false + a .paywall hasPart marker but articleBody was NOT truncated in testing -- treat as a soft/cosmetic paywall marker, but re-verify periodically since a tightening would not raise an error.

author.title: Author
author.description: Array of Person objects (raw passthrough) -- unusually rich, includes name/email/jobTitle/description bio fields for LA Times staff writers.

image.title: Image
image.description: Array of ImageObject entries (multiple crops), raw passthrough from ld+json.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag -- observed as false on every sampled article even though articleBody was not truncated.

hasPart.title: Has part (paywall marker)
hasPart.description: Schema.org paywall-signal block ({@type: WebPageElement, isAccessibleForFree: false, cssSelector: '.paywall'}), raw passthrough.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher organization object, if present in the ld+json node.

mainEntityOfPage.title: Main entity of page
mainEntityOfPage.description: Canonical WebPage reference, if present in the ld+json node.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keywords, if present in the ld+json node.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
